basic_info.description: This beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner condo is located in the prestigious Opera Plaza complex, offering bright and comfortable living space. The unit features brand-new flooring and an open floor plan with a sun-filled living room that opens to a private south-facing deckperfect for relaxing or entertaining. The primary bedroom includes an en-suite bath, and every window provides lovely city views, including partial views of the iconic City Hall.    Opera Plaza is a full-service luxury community offering top-notch amenities such as 24-hour security, concierge and package holding services, a heated pool and spa, fitness center, racquetball and pickleball courts, restaurants, a movie theater, a bookstore, and other convenient commercial businesses. This 5th-floor unit is move-in ready and offers the perfect blend of comfort, location, and lifestyle.
